answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 159323 Country: India Title: Since past 3 years searching for bride. Many proposals are coming but still it is unsuccessful. Please suggest any dua for getting married soon. Question: Since past 3 years searching for bride. Many proposals are coming but still it is unsuccessful. Please suggest any dua for getting married soon. Answer ID: 159323 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 745/578/SD=6/1439) Read the below dua thrice after each salah and supplicate, in-shaAllah you shall get married soon: قُلْ إِنَّ الْفَضْلَ بِيَدِ اللّهِ يُؤْتِيهِ مَن يَشَاءُ وَاللّهُ وَاسِعٌ عَلِيمٌ يَخْتَصُّ بِرَحْمَتِهِ مَن يَشَاءُ وَاللّهُ ذُو الْفَضْلِ الْعَظِيمِ . Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
